save_tip: Story missions cannot be replayed. Use the 15 manual save slots before big missions and before any stranger strand you might miss.

stages.detail: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission straight through. Seven missions and all four chapter endings award trophies. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house — it is the one that may be missable. Do not use cheats: they disable trophies.
stages.name: Play the story first

stages.detail: Finish the stranger strands as they appear — do not leave them for the endgame, because five of them close as the story advances. Eight strands earn the Silver Strangers & Freaks, and Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own final-mission trophy. Bret's hunt for a unique animal belongs here too.
stages.name: Strangers & Freaks

stages.detail: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 different races, an arcade game, Cal's fishing challenge, all 18 meditation spots and 250 stunts. Try each of the 9 activity types once along the way. The Shooting Range golds are one of the two hardest tasks in the game — save them for when your aim is practised.
stages.name: Clear the activities

stages.detail: Five bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store robbed without being seen, three shops in a row with your partner, an illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs, plus the one-offs: Combat Focus, the unscheduled VCIA departure, the Rhino and the showroom smash. Plan each getaway before you go in.
stages.name: Crime with your partner

stages.detail: Three card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 discovered vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida, every garage property, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, $100,000 spent in shops and $250,000 laundered through your contacts. Do these as you travel between other stages — they overlap with everything else.
stages.name: Collect while you roam

stages.detail: Finish 50 Challenges and the one-off moments — the Ocean Beach cocktail, the bowling alley, the partnership milestone, the story choices, the second-try comeback, the strange sighting and the melee drive-by. Then clear the 100% checklist for A Long Road (Gold). That pops the Platinum, Vice Got a Price!.
stages.name: Mop-up and 100%

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
warning: Any cheat disables trophies and saving. Do not use cheats until every trophy is earned.
